title: BIM Scheduling Cost Prediction Analysis
desc:
I’m putting together a qualitative study that zeroes in on how Building Information Modeling can sharpen cost-prediction accuracy during the design phase—specifically for project scheduling costs. I already have access to several recent BIM models and project archives; what I need is a researcher who can turn those raw resources into clear, evidence-based insights.

Your role will be to explore current scheduling-cost workflows inside BIM, interview or survey key design-team members, and compare their practices against industry best-practice literature. I’m particularly keen on uncovering the factors that cause early estimates to drift and the adjustments that reliably pull numbers back on track before the drawings are frozen.

Deliverables  
• A concise research plan outlining data-collection methods (interviews, document review, model interrogation)  
• Thematic analysis of findings with direct quotations and model screenshots where relevant  
• Actionable recommendations—both quick wins and longer-horizon process tweaks—aimed at raising scheduling-cost accuracy in future design iterations  
• A slide deck that summarizes the study for non-technical stakeholders

I’m fluent in Revit and Navisworks, so feel free to reference features or plugins that could support the analysis. Clarity, traceability of findings, and practical next steps will be the main success criteria. Let me know your proposed approach and any similar qualitative BIM cost studies you’ve tackled before.

title: Seasoned Real Estate Sales Partner Needed

My brokerage already has access to MLS data, a well-populated CRM (HubSpot), and a library of marketing collateral—what I’m missing is the sales horsepower to convert interest into transactions at scale. If you excel at prospecting, know how to listen to buyer and seller pain points, and can navigate offers, counteroffers, and addenda without losing momentum, you’ll thrive here.  

Key deliverables  
• 15+ fresh, qualified leads per week entered into the CRM  
• Scheduled showings or listing presentations for at least 30 % of those leads  
• Drafted and negotiated purchase or listing agreements that meet client objectives  
• Weekly pipeline report summarizing activity, obstacles, and forecasted closings  

Acceptance criteria  
• Leads must include verified contact info and buying/selling intent  
• Meetings recorded in the CRM within 24 hours of occurrence  
• All contracts to be compliant with local real-estate regulations and brokerage templates  
• Close-of-deal documentation uploaded before commission disbursement  

If you bring a solid track record in real-estate sales, are comfortable working independently, and can start delivering results i

title: BIM Cost-Management Study
desc:
I need a concise, research-driven study that explains how Building Information Modeling (BIM) can streamline cost-management across a construction project. The focus is qualitative: interviews, relevant case studies, and an examination of current literature should form the backbone of the analysis, with clear commentary on where BIM adds measurable value and where gaps still exist.

Please structure the final document so a multidisciplinary audience can understand it—decision-makers, planners, and on-site professionals alike. A short executive summary up front, followed by the main report (10–15 pages) and any appendices for raw findings or reference material, will be perfect. Charts or visualisations straight out of authoring tools such as Revit, Navisworks, or CostX are welcome if they help illustrate key insights.

I am happy to provide access to existing project data and contacts for interviews once we agree on the outline. Let me know your proposed methodology, anticipated sources, and how long you will need to complete a polished, ready-to-share study.

title: UX Research Recruiter for AI Mobile App
desc:
We’re building a mobile AI app that lets people create and share mini-apps simply by chatting with AI.

We’re looking for a freelancer to recruit 30–50 qualified early users located in the United States or Canada for product testing and user research.

You’ll be responsible for finding, screening, and scheduling participants across three groups:

- AI early adopters
- Non-technical creators such as marketers, teachers, students, freelancers, and small-business owners
- Mainstream ChatGPT/AI users who are not developers

All participants must currently live in the U.S. or Canada, be fluent in English, and match our screening criteria.

We care about quality, not bulk signups. No bots, purchased lists, fake users, or low-quality traffic.

Ideal experience:

• UX/user research recruitment
• Beta tester recruitment
• Early-stage startup user acquisition
• Community outreach on Reddit, Discord, X, LinkedIn, or similar channels

Start your proposal with “AI USER RESEARCH”.

Successful work may lead to an ongoing role helping us reach our first 10,000 interested users and 100 paying customers.

title: AI Automation Sales Closer
desc:
I run an AI consultancy that designs and deploys custom automations for companies in multiple verticals. Demand is growing, so I’m expanding the outbound team and need a native-English caller who genuinely enjoys cold calling and can turn prospects—primarily tech-focused startups—into qualified, eager clients.

What the day-to-day looks like  
• Place targeted cold calls from our vetted lead lists, following an opening script you’ll help refine.  
• Listen, probe for pain points, and book discovery meetings for our solutions architects.  
• Keep concise notes in HubSpot so the rest of the team has instant context.  

Support you receive  
– Full product and industry training (our stack spans OpenAI, LangChain, Zapier, Make, and custom Python microservices).  
– Battle-tested talk tracks, objection-handling guides, and live call coaching.  
– Weekly pipeline reviews, so you always know quota and next steps.

What I’m looking for  
• Proven confidence on the phone—if you thrive on the adrenaline of the first thirty seconds, you’ll fit right in.  
• Familiarity with the IT/technology landscape and the language of fast-moving startups.  
• Reliable availability across North-American business hours.

Deliverables & metrics  
1. Minimum of 40 live dials per day.  
2. At least 8 qualified meetings booked per week.  
3. All activity logged same-day in HubSpot.

This is a long-term role with performance bonuses and clear growth paths into senior closer or account-executive positions.

title: Ultra-Realistic Muscle Car EDM Video
desc:
My new EDM track runs 1 min 56 sec and lives on hard-hitting drops, so every cut, flare, and camera shake in the video has to lock perfectly to those beats—that timing is the single biggest priority for me.  

The visual concept is simple but demanding: high-detail muscle or sports cars tearing through rain-slick, night-time roads, exhausts spitting flames that light up the darkness. Think Batmobile-style cinematography, only with present-day performance machines. I’m partial to seeing a Nissan GT-R R35 in the mix, yet I’m open to any modern or classic muscle icon as long as the shots feel authentic.  

You may use AI generation, Unreal, Blender, Houdini, real footage, or any software workflow you like; the method is yours, but the end result must pass as photoreal—no floaty physics, no rubber-looking tires, no cartoon fire.  

Acceptance criteria  
• Full-length 1:56 video delivered in 4K (and a 1080p down-convert) with my mastered audio track correctly synced.  
• Muscle cars on dark roads with backfiring flames featured prominently.  
• On-beat scene changes and VFX accents throughout; no noticeable drift from the rhythm.  
• Color grade and motion blur consistent with cinematic night driving.  
• Source project files or a reproducible workflow archive so I can generate alternate cuts later if needed.  

If this sounds like your niche, tell me briefly how you’ll tackle realism and beat-syncing, and include one or two links to comparable work.

title: Residential KNX Installation & Integration
desc:
I am preparing a new residential build and need a KNX specialist to carry out the complete installation and initial configuration of the system. The scope covers full wiring, commissioning, and integration of three key subsystems already specified by the architect and MEP engineer:  

• Lighting control  
• Heating & cooling (HVAC)  
• Security / intrusion detection  

You will work from the electrical and KNX topology drawings and coordinate with my electrician to make sure all lines, power supplies, couplers and actuators are installed to KNX standards. Once the hardware is in place, I need you to program the ETS project, load group addresses, and test every function room-by-room so that scenes, schedules and safety interlocks operate reliably.

Acceptance will be based on:  
• Clean, labelled ETS project file handed over  
• All devices responding in ETS diagnostics with no red flags  
• Demonstrated control of lights, climate zones and alarm sensors from a single KNX panel and the mobile visualisation app we select together  

If you have recent residential references and can start on-site within the next four weeks, please outline your timeline and the main brands you prefer working with.

title: Freeform In-Ground Swimming Pool Design
desc:
I’m at the very first concept stage for a free-form, in-ground swimming pool and need a complete architectural and civil/structural design package that can move smoothly from vision to permitting and construction.

Scope of work  
– Translate my rough ideas into a cohesive layout that optimises circulation, safety zones, decking and landscaping tie-ins.  
– Produce full architectural drawings (plan, sections, elevations) in CAD, ready for local permit submission.  
– Provide sealed structural calculations and reinforcement details for the shell, footing, retaining structures and any water features.  
– Recommend equipment sizing (pumps, filtration, lighting) and materials compatible with the design.  
– Supply a 3D model or realistic render so I can visualise the finished pool before committing to build.

Acceptance criteria  
• Drawings meet current residential pool codes in my jurisdiction and are deliverable in both PDF and editable DWG formats.  
• Structural set is calculation-backed and stamped (or stamp-ready) by a certified engineer.  
• All dimensions, slopes and tolerances are clearly indicated to ±5 mm accuracy.  
• Final deliverable package arrives complete within the agreed timeline, with one revision cycle included.

AutoCAD, Revit, or similar BIM tools are fine; just let me know your preference so we stay compatible.

title: RPEQ Certification for Septic Design
desc:
I have completed a set of engineering drawings for a new septic system and spray irrigation area that utilises an Aerobic Treatment Unit (ATU). Before I submit anything to council, I need a Queensland-registered RPEQ to confirm that the design complies with all relevant state and local on-site sewerage regulations and then place your official stamp on the drawing set.

You will receive the current PDF/DWG plan, design calculations, soil report and manufacturer literature. Your role is to:

• Review the entire package with a focus on full regulatory compliance, especially the layout, hydraulic capacity and land application area sizing.  
• Mark up or note any minor amendments needed so the design can be certified without reservation.  
• Once satisfied, issue your RPEQ sign-off and digital stamp (and Form 15/16 if required) on the final PDF.

A brief summary confirming compliance and any conditions or recommendations must accompany the stamped file. Let me know your expected turnaround time and any additional information you require to begin the review.

title: Redraw House Plans from Sketches
desc:

title: Home Appliance Store Data Entry
desc:
I’m expanding my online store’s catalogue of home appliances and need a detail-oriented freelancer to add each new item directly in the store’s admin panel. Your job is to take the information I supply—model name, key specs, pricing and any imagery—and enter it exactly as provided, double-checking spelling, category placement and variant options before saving the listing.

We will work in small batches so I can review and approve as we go. Accuracy is critical: customers rely on these listings to compare features, so every field must be complete and consistent. If you notice missing or unclear details while uploading, flag them so I can send the correct data.

All work is performed inside the store’s web dashboard; no external spreadsheets are needed. A short Loom walkthrough of the interface will be available before you start, and I’m always on chat for questions. Once you’ve finished a batch, export a quick report showing the SKUs you added so I can reconcile inventory.

Deliverables:
• Every assigned home-appliance product live in the store, fully populated and error-free.
• Final SKU report confirming successful upload.

If you have solid product-listing experience and a sharp eye for consistency, let’s get started.

title: Commission-Only Sales Representative
desc:
We build affordable, professional websites for US-based trades businesses (plumbers, electricians, roofers, HVAC, landscapers, etc.) — with a unique hook: we build a working demo of the prospect's site for free before they pay anything.

We're looking for a commission-only sales rep to run the full cycle: find prospects, cold call, book/run the pitch, and close. This is 100% performance-based — no hourly pay, no retainer, no base salary. You earn only when a deal closes and payment clears.

What you'll do:
- Source your own prospect lists (no website, or outdated website, US trades businesses)
- Cold call and pitch our free-demo offer
- Handle objections and close the sale
- (Optional/bonus) Pitch our $150/month hosting retainer

Compensation:
- 50% commission on every closed website sale ($1,500 standard price = $750 per sale)
- Paid in two installments: half when the client's deposit clears, half when final payment clears
- Plus a $50 bonus on every closed sale, since our monthly hosting retainer is included in every deal

What we provide:
- Pricing and offer sheet
- Call script and objection-handling framework
- Fast turnaround on demo builds (~40 minutes per site) so you can show prospects something concrete quickly

What we're looking for:
- Proven cold-calling / appointment-setting / closing experience — ideally in web design, digital marketing, or home-services sales
- Confident, natural phone communication
- Must comply with US TCPA / Do Not Call rules: identify yours

title: Chinese-English Email Support VA
desc:
I need ongoing help managing our customer support inbox for a UK-based business that serves both English- and Chinese-speaking customers. Every weekday you will log in to our shared Gmail account, reply to incoming messages in the customer’s language, and keep the conversation friendly, concise, and solution-focused.  

Clear, accurate translation between Chinese and English is essential; many enquiries involve product questions and shipment updates, so tone and detail must remain consistent across both languages. You’ll follow the reply templates I provide, adapt them when a situation falls outside the script, and tag any message that needs my direct input.  

Because Gmail is the sole platform we use, you should already be comfortable with labels, filters, canned responses, and the basic shortcuts that keep response times low. Our customers expect an answer within 4 hours during UK business hours, and I’ll track that window through the built-in Google analytics.  

Deliverables each day:  
• Inbox cleared to “zero” or tagged for my review  
• Replies written in fluent, natural English or Simplified Chinese as appropriate  
• Brief summary in a shared Google Sheet noting any escalations, refunds, or follow-ups required  

If you communicate clearly, keep the tone warm yet professional, and maintain that four-hour SLA, we’ll expand your role into light marketing email tasks later on.

title: UK Health Blog Writers Needed
desc:
My health & wellness platform publishes a steady stream of formal, evidence-based blog posts aimed at a UK readership, and I now need extra hands to keep pace with demand. Assignments will range from nutrition and fitness to mental-health coverage, always written in clear, authoritative UK English that reflects current medical guidance.

Here’s how the collaboration works. I send a brief with headline, key points, word-count target and deadline; you return a polished Google Doc that reads smoothly, cites reputable sources and follows the agreed structure. Workload is flexible—take on a few pieces each week or scale up to a full-time rhythm as long as deadlines are met. Because this is an open-ended engagement, consistency and reliability are just as valuable as writing flair.

Deliverables for each article
• 800–1,200-word formal blog post  
• SEO-friendly title, H2/H3 sub-headings and meta description  
• Source list (links or Harvard style) verifying every claim  
• Proofread copy in UK English, ready to publish

If you have a solid grasp of health & wellness topics, can write with an authoritative tone and are comfortable committing to an ongoing schedule, I look forward to reading your work.

title: English-Somali Translation Project
desc:
I have a set of English materials that I need rendered accurately and naturally into Somali. The text is a mix of everyday language and a few domain-specific terms, so I’m looking for someone who is truly bilingual and can preserve both meaning and tone without sounding literal or stiff.

You’ll receive the source files in Word and PDF. I’ll need the Somali version returned in the same layout, fully proofread and ready to share. Please keep any headings, bullet points, and basic formatting intact so that the translated file mirrors the original.

Deliverables:  
• Final Somali document(s) in the original file format  
• A brief glossary of any key terms you had to research or standardise  

Accuracy and clarity are my top priorities, so feel free to flag anything ambiguous before proceeding. Let me know your turnaround time and any previous projects that show your grasp of formal and conversational Somali.
